DML.SELECT: SELECT plan_id as "planId", plan_order_id as "planOrderId", command_element_type_id as "commandElementTypeId", element_type_id as "elementTypeId", command_element_id as "commandElementId", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM conf.plan_order_command_elements WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO conf.plan_order_command_elements (plan_id, plan_order_id, command_element_type_id, element_type_id, command_element_id, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:planId, :planOrderId, :commandElementTypeId, :elementTypeId, :commandElementId, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE conf.plan_order_command_elements SET command_element_type_id = :commandElementTypeId, element_type_id = :elementTypeId, command_element_id = :commandElementId, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE plan_id = :planId AND plan_order_id = :planOrderId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM conf.plan_order_command_elements WHERE plan_id = :planId AND plan_order_id = :planOrderId
